card.name: Word endings like isoniazid, gigabit, port
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word that is nearly complete, mainly the ending of "isoniazid" and the word "port" after "intravenous". Also fires on "gig" and "abit" in "gigabit".

modes.label: Isoniazid ending
modes.description: The final piece "id" completing the antituberculosis drug name isoniazid in drug interaction lists.

modes.label: Gigabit
modes.description: Pieces of "gigabit" in a networking text about fiber bandwidth.

card.plain: It marks the end of a few specific words, such as isoniazid and intravenous port, once the word is basically complete.
